summary: A short notice that the network graphics meeting planned for October 17 to 19, 1971 at Stanford AI would be postponed because it clashed with the Network Working Group meeting. A new date would be announced later, probably in November or December.

plainLanguage.summary: The Network Graphics meeting planned for October was postponed because of a scheduling conflict with the Network Working Group meeting. A new date would be announced later.

subtitle: The Network Graphics meeting is postponed because of a scheduling conflict.

tldr.problem: The planned Network Graphics meeting conflicted with the Network Working Group meeting schedule.
tldr.mechanism: Organizers postponed the meeting and planned to announce a new date in another RFC.
tldr.outcome: The meeting was expected to take place in the San Francisco area in November or early December.

today: RFC 232 is a meeting postponement notice published in September 1971. The unit metadata lists its status as Unknown.

sections.title: Reason for Postponement
sections.content: The Network Graphics meeting had been tentatively scheduled at Stanford AI for October 17-19. The Network Working Group was meeting October 10-14, so organizers decided to postpone the graphics meeting.
sections.plainLanguage: The graphics meeting was postponed after another network meeting was scheduled shortly before it. Organizers wanted to avoid holding the events back to back.

sections.title: Expected New Date
sections.content: The RFC says that a new meeting date would be established and announced in a later RFC. The expected location was the San Francisco area, with a possible date in November or early December.
sections.plainLanguage: The organizers planned to choose a new date and announce it later. They expected the meeting to be in the San Francisco area.

sections.title: Previous Scheduling
sections.content: The October dates had been tentatively set at the previous Network Graphics meeting held in July at MIT. The September notice reports the decision to change those tentative dates.
sections.plainLanguage: The October dates had been tentative since the group's July meeting. This notice updates participants that the schedule changed.
